messages:
Deploy Bot: [deploybot] Beginning staged rollout v2.7.0 -> US=20%, EU=0%, APAC=0%. Change window 2024-10-22 21:00-01:00 UTC. Holdpoints @ 20% increments.
Yuki: US canary live. Monitoring search and payments routes.
Noah: US warm nodes 46/60. p50=97ms, p95=205ms. No 5xx.
Deploy Bot: US holdpoint healthy: ok=68/68, errs=0.
Marta: Queuing EU ramp to 5% after US stable. EU reserved pool 30 GPUs, alloc=75%.
Deploy Bot: EU ramp command submitted -> target 5%.
SRE Oncall: EU @5% (3m): p50=115ms, p95=240ms, errs=0. Warmpool +1%.
Kai: Noting KV-cache sticky off for EU by default; consider enabling if p95 climbs.
Yuki: Enable KV-cache sticky for EU slice now.
Deploy Bot: KV-cache sticky flag toggled for eu-slice.
SRE Oncall: EU (6m): p95 jumped to 560ms over last 2m, errors on one payment route at 0.7%. No OOMs yet. Warmpool usage up +9% in last 5m.
Noah: Payment route latency spike is customer-impacting; business asked for minimal disruption.
Marta: Two options: 1) pin EU to v2.6.9 (full rollback), or 2) switch EU to fallback lighter model variant v2.7.0-compact (less memory, slightly lower quality) for payment routes only. Thoughts?
Yuki: Prefer variant fallback for payments first to avoid global rollback. If variant still fails, pin and throttle.
SRE Oncall: Agreed. Rollback triggers still: p95 >2x baseline for >=10m, route errs >1% sustained 5m, GPU OOMs >=2 in 4m. We're below those thresholds except p95 >2x.
Noah: Quick runbook snippet to perform variant fallback and pin if needed:
```
redwoodctl fallback-variant --region eu --route payments --variant v2.7.0-compact
redwoodctl pin --region eu --version v2.6.9
redwoodctl rollback --release v2.7.0 --reason "eu payment instability"
```
Marta: Executing fallback for payments now. Posting audit note.
Deploy Bot: Command acknowledged: fallback-variant -> payments -> v2.7.0-compact.
SRE Oncall: Payments route switched to compact variant (0m). Monitoring: p95 for payments dropped from 560ms -> 190ms within 90s, errors down to 0.1%.
Noah: Nice. Keep KV-cache sticky enabled and observe broader p95 across other routes.
Yuki: For other routes in EU we'll keep v2.7.0 for now and monitor 10m. If general p95 doesn't stabilize, we'll pin EU entirely.
Infra-Priv Bot: Note: APAC artifact egress needs INF-533 approval to start APAC canary. Ticket open.
Marta: Leaving EU at 5% hold for 12m. If stable, ramp to 25% in next wave. If payment errors spike above 0.8% or p95 >2x baseline, we'll pin EU and throttle to 5% immediately.
SRE Oncall: No OOMs observed. Thermal margin steady. Will escalate if warm node loss >8% in 3m.
Noah: Updating #release-updates with compact-variant fallback and status.
Yuki: Thanks all. Keeping this thread as the audit log. Ping here before any manual pin/rollback.
Deploy Bot: Holdpoint reached. US/EU at 20/5. APAC pending INF-533. Next ramp requires manual ack.
